theorem exists_targetDefectVectorFamily
    (family : RepresentativeShellFamily)
    (L : MathlibAnnex.CStarAlgebra.PureState.GNSClass Limit →
      MathlibAnnex.CStarAlgebra.PureState.SelectedAtomicHilbert completedRootPureState →L[ℂ]
        MathlibAnnex.CStarAlgebra.PureState.SelectedAtomicHilbert completedRootPureState)
    (hLunit : ∀ i, L i ∈ unitary
      (MathlibAnnex.CStarAlgebra.PureState.SelectedAtomicHilbert completedRootPureState →L[ℂ]
        MathlibAnnex.CStarAlgebra.PureState.SelectedAtomicHilbert completedRootPureState))
    (hLsource : ∀ i n, (L i).comp (selectedAtomicRepresentation
      (transportedFlag family i n - transportedFlag family i (n + 1))) =
        representedShellLink family i n)
    {K : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K]
    [CompleteSpace K] (rho : Representation (AtomicTarget L) K)
    (hrho : rho.IsIrreducible) :
    ∃ (eta_o : K) (eta : MathlibAnnex.CStarAlgebra.PureState.GNSClass Limit → K),
      ‖eta_o‖ = 1 ∧
      (∀ n, (restrictedRepresentation L rho) (rootFlag n) eta_o = eta_o) ∧
      Representation.vectorFunctional (restrictedRepresentation L rho) eta_o =
        rootState ∧
      ∀ i,
        ‖eta i‖ = 1 ∧
        (∀ n, (restrictedRepresentation L rho)
          (transportedFlag family i n) (eta i) = eta i) ∧
        (Unitary.linearIsometryEquiv
          (representedGeneratorUnitary L hLunit rho i) : K ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] K) (eta i) =
            eta_o ∧
        Representation.vectorFunctional (restrictedRepresentation L rho) (eta i) =
          (MathlibAnnex.CStarAlgebra.PureState.representative completedRootPureState i).1

content.assumptions:
Let $A$ be the completed CAR algebra, obtained by completing the matrix stages $M_{2^n}(\mathbb C)$ with embeddings $a\mapsto a\otimes I_2$. Let $f_n$ be the image of the first diagonal matrix unit. Thus $f_0=1$ and the $f_n$ form a decreasing sequence of projections. The root state $\omega$ has value $a_{00}$ on a matrix $a$ in any stage.

Choose a pure state $\varphi_j$ in each unitary-equivalence class $j\in I$ of pure-state GNS representations, with $\varphi_o=\omega$ at the root index $o$. Denote its complete complex GNS space, unital star representation and unit cyclic vector by $(H_j,\pi_j,\xi_j)$. Set $\mathcal H=\bigoplus_{j\in I}H_j$ and $\pi=\bigoplus_{j\in I}\pi_j$. The index set need not be countable.

A supplied shell family consists of unital complex star automorphisms $\alpha_j$ with $\varphi_j\circ\alpha_j=\omega$ and elements $w_{j,n}\in A$. Put $f_{j,n}=\alpha_j(f_n)$. Their support identities are $w_{j,n}^*w_{j,n}=f_{j,n}-f_{j,n+1}$ and $w_{j,n}w_{j,n}^*=f_n-f_{n+1}$. At the root, $\alpha_o$ is the identity and $w_{o,n}=f_n-f_{n+1}$.

Let $L_j$ be unitaries on $\mathcal H$ satisfying $L_j\pi(f_{j,n}-f_{j,n+1})=\pi(w_{j,n})$ for every $j,n$. Let $T\subseteq B(\mathcal H)$ be the norm-closed unital star algebra generated by $\pi(A)$ and all $L_j$. Write $\iota:A\to T$ for $\iota(a)=\pi(a)$ and $g_j\in T$ for the element represented by $L_j$. For a unital complex star representation $\rho:T\to B(K)$ on a complete complex Hilbert space, put $\sigma=\rho\circ\iota$ and $V_j=\rho(g_j)$. Each $V_j$ is unitary because $\rho$ preserves the unit, products and adjoints. Write $F_j=\bigcap_{n\geq0}\operatorname{ran}\sigma(f_{j,n})$ for the common fixed space of the $j$-th transported flag. The representation $\rho$ is nonzero and irreducible, in the sense that its only closed reducing subspaces are $\{0\}$ and $K$. No root normalization $L_o=I$ and no prescribed action of $L_j$ on the atomic cyclic vectors is required.
content.conclusion: All chosen vector states share one root vector: the family can be defined by $\eta_j=V_j^*\zeta$. These pointed state realizations supply the vector data for [the cyclic-sum capture theorem](https://github.com/r-tanaka-math/mathlib-annex/blob/437e6e46228bbb8e91211ebded349d7a30020e73/MathlibAnnex/Analysis/CStarAlgebra/CAR/CaptureRange.lean#L32-L261). The present result does not assert that an individual $\eta_j$ is cyclic for all of $K$, or that the limiting fixed spaces are one-dimensional.
content.display_title: A common root vector realizes every selected state through the generators
content.lean_realization_notes: The common root vector $\zeta$ and the member $\eta_o$ indexed by the root class have the same root state, but their equality is not imposed here. The additional normalization $L_o=I$, used in that cyclic-sum capture theorem, would give $V_o=I$ and hence $\eta_o=\zeta$. No orthogonality or surjectivity conclusion is included in this declaration.
content.natural_language_statement:
For the supplied shell family and nonzero irreducible representation $\rho$ described below, there exist a unit vector $\zeta\in K$ and unit vectors $\eta_j\in K$, one for each $j\in I$, with the following properties for every $n$ and $a\in A$:

$\sigma(f_n)\zeta=\zeta,\qquad\langle\zeta,\sigma(a)\zeta\rangle=\omega(a)$.

For every $j\in I$ they satisfy

$\sigma(f_{j,n})\eta_j=\eta_j,\qquad V_j\eta_j=\zeta,\qquad\langle\eta_j,\sigma(a)\eta_j\rangle=\varphi_j(a)$.

Here $\sigma=\rho\circ\iota$, and inner products are linear in the second argument.
content.one_sentence_role: Builds a compatible family of unit vectors from a surviving residual space and identifies their CAR vector states.

proof_steps.text: The [nonvanishing theorem](https://github.com/r-tanaka-math/mathlib-annex/blob/437e6e46228bbb8e91211ebded349d7a30020e73/MathlibAnnex/Analysis/CStarAlgebra/CAR/CaptureZero.lean#L104-L159) gives $i_0$ and $0\ne x\in F_{i_0}$. Normalize $x$ to $\eta^{(0)}=x/\|x\|$ and put $\zeta=V_{i_0}\eta^{(0)}$. Unitarity preserves norm one. Reconstruction maps $F_{i_0}$ onto the root common range, so all $\sigma(f_n)$ fix $\zeta$.

For every $a\in A$, the source estimates are $\|f_na f_n-\omega(a)f_n\|\to0$ and $\|f_{j,n}a f_{j,n}-\varphi_j(a)f_{j,n}\|\to0$. Apply the contractive representation $\sigma$ and take a matrix coefficient at a unit vector fixed by the corresponding projections. Self-adjointness and fixedness make that coefficient equal to the constant difference between its vector state and the indicated source state. Norm convergence forces the difference to be zero. In particular this identifies the state of $\zeta$ as $\omega$.

Define $\eta_j=V_j^*\zeta$ for each $j$. The same reconstruction equivalence, used in the reverse direction, gives $\eta_j\in F_j$. Unitarity gives $\|\eta_j\|=1$ and $V_j\eta_j=\zeta$; membership in the ranges of projections gives their fixedness.

Apply the transported compression estimate to this unit fixed vector. It yields $\langle\eta_j,\sigma(a)\eta_j\rangle=\varphi_j(a)$ for every $a\in A$ and every $j$. The construction uses one root vector throughout rather than separately choosing unrelated vector-state realizations.

content.proof_summary: Choose a unit vector in one nonzero limiting fixed space and apply its represented generator to obtain $\zeta$ in the root fixed space. The CAR norm-compression estimates identify both vector states. For every other index, pull this same $\zeta$ back by the corresponding unitary. The fixed-space equivalence in [shell reconstruction](https://github.com/r-tanaka-math/mathlib-annex/blob/437e6e46228bbb8e91211ebded349d7a30020e73/MathlibAnnex/Analysis/CStarAlgebra/CAR/TargetReconstruction.lean#L121-L178) places the pulled-back vector in the correct fixed space, and compression again identifies its state.

citations.label: The root state bundled with its purity proof

guide: Here `Limit` is $A$, [`completedRootPureState`](https://github.com/r-tanaka-math/mathlib-annex/blob/437e6e46228bbb8e91211ebded349d7a30020e73/MathlibAnnex/Analysis/CStarAlgebra/CAR/CompletedSource.lean#L16-L18) is the root state $\omega$ bundled with its purity proof, and `SelectedAtomicHilbert completedRootPureState` is the atomic Hilbert space $\mathcal H$. `eta_o` is the common root vector $\zeta$, while `eta i` is the vector $\eta_j$ at the source index `i` corresponding to the mathematical index $j$; `eta_o` does not mean `eta` evaluated at the root index. `vectorFunctional sigma eta` sends $a$ to $\langle\eta,\sigma(a)\eta\rangle$. `representative completedRootPureState i` is the selected state $\varphi_j$ at that same index, and `rootState` is $\omega$. The same `eta_o` occurs in the generator equation for every index.
